Hi Jasmine,

I signed up earlier today for the Redwood Hosted API and kicked off a short sandbox run with our dataset (approx 1M docs). We're evaluating for semantic search and reranking; would love a guided walkthrough to confirm performance/latency expectations and to get the right batching/kv-caching settings for our workload.

We're a small infra team and would prefer a 45-minute session so we can cover ingestion, a short run, and some runtime tuning. Best windows for us (PST) next week are:
- Tue Jul 7, 09:00–11:00 or
- Thu Jul 9, 13:00–16:00

If those don't work, happy to take a 30-minute intro as a fallback. Also, can the session include a short review of model/quantization recommendations? We plan to bring our CTO (Tom Park) if possible.

Thanks — Alicia
